proof_body:
by
  have key : ∀ (n k : ℕ), Nat.stirlingSecond (n + 1) (k + 1) = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), n.choose j * Nat.stirlingSecond j k := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro k
      cases k with
      | zero => simp [Nat.stirlingSecond]
      | succ k => simp [Nat.stirlingSecond]
    | succ n ih =>
      intro k
      have hp : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1 + 1), (n + 1).choose j * Nat.stirlingSecond j k = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), n.choose j * Nat.stirlingSecond j k + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), n.choose j * Nat.stirlingSecond (j + 1) k := by
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
        simp only [Nat.choose_succ_succ, add_mul]
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        have h1 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), n.choose j * Nat.stirlingSecond j k = n.choose 0 * Nat.stirlingSecond 0 k + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, n.choose (j + 1) * Nat.stirlingSecond (j + 1) k := by
          rw [Finset.sum_range_succ' _ n, add_comm]
        have h2 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), n.choose (j + 1) * Nat.stirlingSecond (j + 1) k = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, n.choose (j + 1) * Nat.stirlingSecond (j + 1) k := by
          rw [Finset.sum_range_succ _ n, Nat.choose_succ_self]; simp
        rw [h1, h2]
        simp
        ring
      rw [hp, ← ih k, Nat.stirlingSecond_succ_succ]
      cases k with
      | zero =>
        simp [Nat.stirlingSecond_succ_zero]
      | succ k =>
        have h3 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), n.choose j * Nat.stirlingSecond (j + 1) (k + 1) = (k + 1) * Nat.stirlingSecond (n + 1) (k + 1 + 1) + Nat.stirlingSecond (n + 1) (k + 1) := by
          rw [ih (k + 1), ih k, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
          rw [Nat.stirlingSecond_succ_succ]; ring
        rw [h3]; ring
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', Nat.stirlingSecond_succ_zero, add_zero]
      simp only [key]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm, Nat.bell_succ']
      rw [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]
      have h4 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), n.choose j * Nat.stirlingSecond j k = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), n.choose j * Nat.bell j := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
        have hj' : j < n + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← ih j hj']
        congr 1
        refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr (by omega)) ?_).symm
        intro k _ hk
        exact Nat.stirlingSecond_eq_zero_of_lt (by simpa using hk)
      rw [h4, ← Finset.sum_range_reflect]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
      have hj' : j < n + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
      simp only [add_tsub_cancel_right]
      rw [Nat.choose_symm (by omega)]
target_source: ∀ n : ℕ, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Nat.stirlingSecond n k = Nat.bell n
